headerDescription.zh: 登录后同步作业与测验到待办
headerDescription.en: Sign in to sync assignments and quizzes to your todos

introBody.zh: 网页登录成功后，应用会读取课程中心的待办列表，把作业与测验导入待办，并在每日自动同步时检查新增内容。
introBody.en: After signing in through the web page, the app reads the LMS todo list, imports assignments and quizzes, and checks for new items during daily auto-sync.

loginSheetTitle.zh: 登录示例大学课程中心
loginSheetTitle.en: Sign in to Demo University LMS

syncNotifTitle.zh: 示例大学自动同步完成

accountChanged.zh: 当前登录的示例大学账号与上次同步的不一致，继续同步需要先清空旧的同步记录。
accountChanged.en: The signed-in Demo University account differs from the last sync. Continuing requires clearing the old sync records.

logoutMessage.zh: 退出后将清除示例大学的同步记录与登录状态，已导入的待办可保留。
logoutMessage.en: Signing out clears Demo University sync records and the session. Imported todos can be kept.

switchMessage.zh: 账号与上次同步的不一致，继续同步需要先清空旧的同步记录。已导入的待办可保留，或一并删除。
switchMessage.en: The account differs from the last sync. Continuing requires clearing the old sync records. Imported todos can be kept or deleted.

serviceBusy.zh: 示例大学服务繁忙，请稍后重试
serviceBusy.en: Demo University service is busy, try again later

invalidCredentials.zh: 示例大学账号或密码不正确
invalidCredentials.en: Incorrect Demo University account or password

sessionNotEstablished.zh: 登录成功但无法读取示例大学数据，请改用网页登录
sessionNotEstablished.en: Signed in but could not read Demo University data. Use the web sign-in instead.

autoLoginDisableMessage.zh: 关闭后不再自动续期示例大学登录，已保存的账号与密码会被删除。
autoLoginDisableMessage.en: Disabling stops renewing the Demo University session and deletes the saved account and password.
